tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-5

Let $S \subseteq \mathbb {R}^3$ be the paraboloid given by $z = x^2 + y^2$, with the induced metric. Prove that $S$ is isotropic at only one point. (Used on p. 56.) \end{exercise}
